correctness.rationale: On S³ the degree-l reproducing Gram equals (l+1)K_l, K_l(x,y)=U_l(<x,y>), and is PSD. At allowed nonantipodal angles the trigonometric formula gives U_{l+L}=U_l, U_{L-2}=-1 and U_{L-1}=0. Diagonal and antipodal endpoint values combine to K_{l+L}=K_l+L(I+(-1)^l P), K_{L-2}=L(I+P)-J, and K_{L-1}=L(I-P). The parity involution decomposition makes the K_{L-2} constant-vector eigenvalue 2L-N, hence N<=2L by PSD; other compatible eigenvalues equal 2L. K_{L-1} is 2L on the odd-parity sample space, so onto for degree L-1. For l=r+kL>=L, the positive 2kL parity-block shift plus PSD K_r gives full rank N/2. N=2L has the unique degree L-2 null vector, yielding sharp eventual threshold L-1. Binary dihedral Dic_n even n has 4n=2L points with exponent L=2n; the 600-cell binary icosahedral group has N=120,L=60. Independent Q8 exact-arithmetic Chebyshev matrix check confirms the degree-2 rank 3, degrees 3..23 rank 4 and 22 periodic recurrence checks.
